title: Git Workflow & Conventions
text: Sometimes mistakes happen need undo something. Don’t panic. Git powerful! Staged changes can restored, unpushed commits can amended tree reset, pushed commits can reverted (adds commit). key distinction: revert safe shared history adds new commit undoes previous one, nothing rewritten. reset --amend rewrite history belong local unshared work . shared branch, including anything already merged main, reach revert reset. Reverting SHA bad commit merge calm, non-destructive fix.
code: # Amend the most recent commit (message and/or newly staged changes) git commit --amend -m "feat: corrected message"  # Unstage a file but keep your edits git restore --staged R/effort_plot.R  # Discard uncommitted edits to a file (cannot be undone, be sure) git restore R/effort_plot.R  # Move HEAD back one commit, KEEP the changes staged git reset --soft HEAD~1  # ...KEEP the changes but unstage them (default) git reset --mixed HEAD~1  # ...DISCARD the commit and all its changes (destructive!) git reset --hard HEAD~1  # Undo an already-pushed / shared commit by adding a new one git revert <commit-sha>

title: Git Workflow & Conventions
text: Bump version usethis::use_version() R; edits DESCRIPTION prompts increment. Bumps always happen chore/bump-v* branch, never inside feature fix branch main. Versioning deliberate act labels coherent set work. NEWS.md gets one entry per version, written performing bump, summarizing every PR merged since last release. Write users, developers. Describe behavior changed, files touched. Put breaking changes first label clearly. PR numbers repo can tagged pound symbol followed number (#PR), PRs another repo can tagged (repo-name#PR). Example NEWS release basic sections. Sections included change falls category.
code: usethis::use_version("minor") # mypackage  *Released: <manually entered date>*  ## **Breaking Changes**  * Description and related PR (#20)    * Intended bullet with another PR (#21)  ## New features  ## Minor improvements and bug fixes  ## Deprecation  ## Documentation improvements

title: Git Workflow & Conventions
text: process releasing new version package performed primary package maintainer. Run --date main, dedicated chore/bump-v#.#.# branch named new version. Sync local main: git checkout main && git pull Create bump branch: git checkout -b chore/bump-v#.#.# NEWS.md, set top header development form new first line (blank line , moving past versions ) # mypackage (development version). Leave empty line every entry except wrapped lines text. Add italicized released date line directly header: *Released YYYY-MM-DD*. Add list curated bullets (#PR) PR tags, using formatting described Versioning & NEWS section. Preview rendered output: pkgdown::build_news(). Bump version: usethis::use_version() (“major”, “minor”, “patch”). rewrites # mypackage (development version) header appropriate next step, edits DESCRIPTION, commits (answer prompt complete). Leave usethis::use_version(push = FALSE) (default). roxygen NAMESPACE changed cycle, run devtools::document(). Run devtools::check() confirm clean. Preview full site: pkgdown::build_site(). catches pkgdown issues devtools::check() evaluate (rendered vignettes, functions missing index, broken crosslinks, etc). Resolve anything check() build_site() flagged, commit fixes. Unless fixes trivial, rerun check() build_site() confirm clean output. Push branch: git push -u origin chore/bump-v#.#.#. Open PR, review, verify checks pass, merge main (squash chore/ branch’s commits). Re-sync local main merged commit: git checkout main && git pull. Tag release main: git tag -v#.#.# -m "creelutils #.#.#". Push tag: git push origin v#.#.#. fires `pkgdown deploy workflow. Verify: Actions run green, changelog links render published site.

title: Summarize HMC Diagnostics from a Stan Fit — get_hmc_diagnostics
text: function reconstructs diagnostics similar rstan::check_hmc_diagnostics() returns formatted character string instead printing console. allows output saved, displayed, logged programmatically. function summarizes key Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) convergence diagnostics Stan model fit. intended help users assess whether tuning needed using available options like adapt_delta, max_treedepth, prior adjustments. diagnostics reported include: Divergent transitions: less 5% post-warmup iterations. Divergences may indicate poor exploration posterior often require increasing adapt_delta (e.g., 0.75 toward 0.95 0.99) reduce step size. Smaller steps improve numerical stability increase runtime. Maximum tree depth: iterations saturate maximum tree depth. Saturation may co-occur high adapt_delta due long trajectories. frequent, consider increasing max_treedepth default (usually 10–12). E-BFMI: metric checks whether energy transitions HMC efficient. E-BFMI 0.2 sign potential sampling issues, though reparameterization (typically recommended) accessible workflow. Instead, consider revisiting prior distributions improve geometry. function adapted return results text, contrast rstan::check_hmc_diagnostics() prints directly console.

title: creelutils 0.3.0
text: ETL now allows estimates “combined” catch groups uploaded creel database (e.g., Coho_Adult|Jack_AD|UM_Kept). Previously, CreelEstimates process database model estimates tables ETL incompatible. See #35 companion update CreelEstimates#83. Updated fishery_catchgroups() queries model catch group lookup table can internally filter catch groups observed catch. new argument ‘observed_only’ (default FALSE) leverages internal helper .observed_catch_group_ids() rather separate step (#35). now defunct fishery_catchgroups_obs() set removed future update. New combine_catch_group() streamlines converting catch group component fields(.e., species, life stage, fin mark, fate) concatenated form separated underscores (e.g., Coho_Adult_AD_Kept) (#35). Updated transform_estimates() standardize naming conventions used across PE BSS model types fields ‘estimate_category’ ‘estimate_type’. Several ‘estimate_type’ categories dropped stratum total tables. removed total table distracted primary intent high-level catch/effort summary. removed stratum table included BSS model convergence diagnostics ever evaluated total level, leading thousands rows per analysis_id never looked . volume rows BSS stratum estimates subsequently decreased ~30-40% (#35). New finalize_analysis_lut() consolidates several steps occurring within export_estimates() single process extends analysis session-specific metadata created CreelEstimates’ generate_analysis_lut(). Several additional metadata columns also added ‘analysis_lut’ (#35).

title: creelutils 0.3.0
text: export_estimates() now calls write_lut, write_stratum, write_total DBI::dbWithTransaction(). ensures rows successfully appended database tables batch. expected row counts differ database connection drops transaction, three tables rolled back unit. New internal function .resolve_conn() streamlines lazy data connections opened stale connections passed querying function handled. Previously fetch_db_table() wrappers independently validated connections connect_creel_db() (#35). stale closed connection provided argument now produce informative error rather opening connection ‘prod’ default. prevents bug connection ‘test’ silently change connection ‘prod’ produced confusing results.
